configuration_element.@description: Crystal Oscilaltor Bypass Enable.
Enables the internal capacitor banks on the EXTAL and XTAL pins that vary the load capacitance on these pins. This bit must be set to '1' simultaneously with the OSC_EN being set to '1'.

enable.@description: Can be enabled by selecting Enabled in {{VBAT_OSCCTLA_OSC_EN}} and the bypass disabled in {{VBAT_OSC32K_CTRL_OSC_BYP_EN_CFG}} settings.

constraint.@description: The Crystal load capacitance enable bit must be enabled together with the oscillator. This setting cannot be disabled.

configuration_element.@description: Selects the internal capacitance for the XTAL pin from the capacitor bank.
